description:
Every exchange the Mangrove platform tracks, with per-exchange tier and 24h volume. Use it when the user asks what exchanges are supported or wants to browse the exchange universe rather than a single venue.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: list_exchanges
